chapter: The jazz war with Leonard Feather
title: Hodes sues Feather for defamation
summary: Hodes sued Feather for $100,000 for defamation. Feather settled for $250, costs and a subscription to Jazz Record.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: I never thought one way or another. But this is how that case ended. Now, I sued him, sued him for $100,000. And --

During that same period when I was getting smacked. Instead of taking to my fists, which I can't use very well, anyway, I found that out the hard way. I took him to -- I had a friend, a lawyer, who again I befriended the lawyer's son. And he says, sure, I'll take care of it. He told me I got a bad case; it's hard to beat him, but I'll try anyway.
Well, what did he say, now, defamation of character?
Yeah, yeah. And what happened was, Leonard settled out of court for $250 and court costs. And one subscription to Jazz Record. I insisted on it. That's all I wanted out of him.
